title: RSI: Coverage
question: Should capture cover every shared skill across your Mac, PC and cloud, including explicit commands, automatically selected skills and skills called by other skills?
answer:
**Question:** Should capture cover every shared skill across your Mac, PC and cloud, including explicit commands, automatically selected skills and skills called by other skills?

**Recommended answer:** Yes. Cover those uses, including projects that have no Workbench yet. Track third-party skills too, while keeping their repair ownership distinct.

**Why:** I assumed host-wide coverage; project-only setup would miss first use and work outside an adopted project.

**Intended impact:** Defines the coverage promise and which environments and invocation paths must be verified.
